messages:
jen: Heads-up — support flagged that the console's 'Auto fallback' flow is confusing for SREs. They expected a simple toggle but there are three nested options and no clear audit trail. Screenshot + example infra ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1723 :eyes:
akash: Saw that. Which parts are confusing? the degrade modes, the error triggers, or the rollout visibility?
maria: All three. SRE said they flipped the toggle and later couldn't tell why traffic was routed to the backup model. No event in the audit log that matched the change. :grimacing:
jen: Exactly. The UI shows "Auto fallback: enabled" but the operator had also selected "silent degrade" and set a sampling 1%. The phrasing made them think it was full fallback.
sam: Oof. We should: 1) change the toggle copy, 2) surface the selected degrade mode in the top banner, 3) add a compact audit entry when a policy is applied.
akash: Agreed. For the audit entry, do we record every decision or just policy changes? full per-decision logs would be huge. ops-bot: Automation note: we currently emit decision samples at 0.1% for fallback reasons and full policy-change events.
maria: Right — per-decision logs are sampled. But the missing item is a human-readable policy-change entry: who changed it, which environment, and which sub-options (mode, trigger, sample).
jen: Minimal requirement from SRE: when a policy is toggled, the console should show a one-line audit event like: "Auto fallback ENABLED (silent, sample=1%, triggers=[timeout, 500]) by jen@redwood". That's all they need to triage.
sam: UX idea: instead of burying sub-options under an expandable section, surface a read-only summary pill next to the toggle. e.g., [Auto fallback: ON — silent · sample=1% · triggers: latency, 429] with a chevron to edit.
akash: Implementation note: backend already stores the policy as JSON. e.g.:
```json
{
  "policy_id": "pf-8a3",
  "enabled": true,
  "mode": "silent",
  "sample_pct": 1,
  "triggers": ["latency_over_1s", "5xx_rate>2%"]
}
```
akash: We can add a lightweight audit event emitter on policy-change endpoint. We'll need to plumb user + req id.
maria: Also add a compact telemetry tag on rollout results so the UI can show a link "Why did I fallback?" that opens sampled decisions for that timeframe. Not full logs, just aggregated counts and top reasons.
jen: Priority: P2. But SRE wants a quick patch for the audit message copy/UI before next week's demo. Can we do a small PR that just surfaces the policy summary pill + the audit entry?
sam: I can take the pill UI. akash can you add the audit event?
akash: Yep. I’ll add an endpoint hook and emit event to event-log stream. ops-bot: Event created: evt-8234 will be emitted on policy updates (dev).
maria: I'll design microcopy for the pill and the audit event description. Will post in #design in 1hr. :thumbsup:
jen: Thanks. If we can ship a dev-preview by Thu, SRE can validate. Add a quick acceptance test that ensures the audit entry contains mode + sample + triggers.
akash: Will do. I'll open a PR and link it to INF-1723.
sam: FYI we should also update the API spec (openapi) to document the additional audit payload fields. small follow-up.
jen: Great. For tracking: INF-1723 (SRE), UX task in DES-4041, backend INF-1723-1. We'll reconvene after PR review. :white_check_mark:
